title: Number of Universal Life Insurance Policies One Owner May Hold
content:
**Guideline.** An owner may hold any number of Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policies on lives in which the owner has an insurable interest. The number of policies one owner holds is not capped; the face amount carried on any one insured life is governed by the aggregate face limit per insured.

| Question | Answer under this guideline |
|---|---|
| Is there a maximum number of Universal Life Insurance policies per owner? | No; the count is not capped |
| On whose lives may the owner hold them? | On lives in which the owner has an insurable interest |
| What limits the coverage on one insured? | The aggregate face limit per insured, not the number of policies |

**Hypothetical illustration.** An owner who already holds three Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policies (one on the owner's own life and two on the lives of family members in whom the owner has an insurable interest) is not refused a fourth on the ground of the number of policies held; whether the fourth may be issued on a given insured turns on the face already in force on that insured.
